title: What costroid validate --json prints, version 0.2
description: What costroid validate found in one configuration file: whether it is valid, invalid or absent, each place it breaks the schema, and the policy pack a valid file names.

file.description: The file as it was named, costroid.yml when none was, or standard input.

state.description: valid: the file holds to the schema. invalid: it breaks it, and validate exits 1. absent: no file was named and the directory holds no costroid.yml, so the defaults apply.

pack.description: The policy pack a valid file names, null when it names none or the file is not valid.

path.description: The pack's path as policy_pack names it.

file.description: Where validate looked for the pack, beside the file it validated. Empty when it had nowhere to look, as for standard input.

state.description: valid: the pack compiles as a check compiles it. invalid: it does not, or it is over 64 KiB, and validate exits 1. unread: validate found no file to compile.

message.description: The fault of a pack that is not valid, or why validate did not read it.

pointer.description: Where in the file, as a JSON pointer. Empty for the document.
